rooks.label: Discord connector
rooks.description: Keeps the TO DO notebook and the Discord bot's tickets and suggestions in step: a ticket opens an idea and an investigation, an outcome or a closure goes back to the bot. Written with the public SDK only.
rooks.author: Rooks
